# Archive Wholesale

> UK vintage clothing wholesaler based in Lancashire, England. Branded vintage
> sportswear and designer pieces — Lacoste, Ralph Lauren, Chaps, Nike, Champion,
> adidas, Fila, Reebok, The North Face, Columbia, Sergio Tacchini, Tommy
> Hilfiger, Nautica, Carhartt, Dickies, Juicy Couture, Von Dutch, Harley-Davidson,
> Patagonia, Morgan, Stone Island, Moncler, Burberry and more — sorted,
> hand-graded and sold to vintage shops, market traders and online resellers. Trading arm of
> Milltown Archive (MANCH LTD). Wholesale only; no single pieces.

Two ways to buy:
- Reseller boxes: fixed-price boxes of branded pieces, from a 10-piece Starter Box at £90. A women's Y2K designer mix and a men's designer mix in 10 or 20 pieces.
- Counted lots: by product or brand, in lots of 10, 25 or 50 pieces, with a per-piece price that falls as the lot grows.

All standard lots are Grade A/B: a mix of Grade A (no visible faults) and
Grade B (minor imperfections, fully saleable), with no Grade C. Every piece is
checked by hand and every branded piece is guaranteed genuine. Product photographs are a representative sample of each line;
exact pieces, brands and colourways vary with each intake.

Ships from Lancashire, United Kingdom, to the UK, Ireland and mainland Europe.
Prices in GBP. Enquiries by WhatsApp (+44 7897 740194) or email
(info@archivewholesale.com).

Brands by lot (each lot is a mix; brands vary with intake):
- Premium vintage hoodies and sweatshirts: Chaps Ralph Lauren, Nautica, Champion, Nike, Guess.
- Jackets and windbreaker mix: Sergio Tacchini, adidas, Nike, Fila, Columbia, The North Face, Reebok, Tommy Hilfiger, Ralph Lauren.
- Women's Y2K designer mix box: Harley-Davidson, Von Dutch, Juicy Couture, Nike, adidas, Patagonia, Morgan, Reebok, Ralph Lauren.
- Polos: Lacoste, Polo Ralph Lauren, Tommy Hilfiger.
- Luxury: Stone Island, Missoni, Valentino, Moncler, Burberry, Versace.

## Key pages

- [All products](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/products): every lot with lot sizes and per-piece prices.
- [Reseller boxes](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/collections/reseller-boxes): fixed-price boxes, from £90.
- [Grading guide](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/grading-guide): what Grade A, B and C mean and how lots are graded.
- [Brands](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/brands): browse by label — every brand page lists the lots that label appears in.
- [Search](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/search?q=): search lots by brand, garment or collection.
- [Product types](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/types): polos and t-shirts, jumpers and sweats, jackets, footwear, accessories.
- [Contact](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/contact): trade enquiries.
